channel.title: The Kyiv Independent - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Kyiv Independent (kyivindependent.com)

item.title: Hungary, Slovakia spat with Ukraine deepens as Budapest threatens to block new EU sanctions
item.description: Hungary said it would block the EU's new sanctions package against Russia over halted oil deliveries through Ukraine, the latest development in a deepening spat between Ukraine and its neighbors, Slovakia and Hungary, over Russian oil imports.

item.title: Russia hits American sweets factory with missile in northeastern Ukraine
item.description: The factory, located in Trostianets in Sumy Oblast, was struck by a missile, Ukraine's Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said. The plant has operated since the 1990s, and produces a range of well-known products, including Oreo and Milka.

item.title: Moscow shuts down all 4 airports during Ukrainian drone attack, Russian officials say
item.description: Twenty drones were shot down en route to Moscow during the afternoon of Feb. 22, Mayor Sergey Sobyanin claimed.

item.title: Explosions rock Ukraine’s capital and outskirts as Russia launches mass missile attack, killing 1, injuring 17
item.description: Several rounds of explosions were reported in Kyiv overnight on Feb. 22, leaving a mother and her child injured as Russia launched ballistic missiles at Ukraine.

item.title: Ukraine war latest: Ukraine hits Russian planes, ships in Crimea, artillery in major strikes on occupied territories
item.description: Key developments on Feb. 21-22: Ukraine hits Russian planes, ships in Crimea, artillery in major strikes on occupied territoriesUkraine confirms Flamingo strike on key Russian ballistic missile factoryRussia hits American sweets factory with missile in northeastern UkraineExplosions rock Ukraine's capital and outskirts as Russia launches

item.title: 'The attack was organized by Russia' — Suspected terrorist strike in Lviv kills police officer, injures 25
item.description: A woman has been arrested in connection to a suspected terrorist attack that killed a police officer and injured 25 others in the Western city of Lviv in the early hours of Sunday morning, Ukrainian authorities said.

item.title: Iran signs secret missile deal with Russia, FT reports
item.description: The arms deal was signed in Moscow in December, and requires Russia to send Iran 500 "Verba" Man-Portable Air-Defense System (MANPADS) launch units and 2,500 9M336 surface-to-air missiles over three years, the Financial Times reported.

item.title: Ukraine strikes oil depot, air defenses in Russian-occupied territories, military confirms
item.description: Ukraine's Unmanned Systems Forces hit an oil depot in occupied Luhansk and destroyed two Russian Tor air defense systems, valued at over $50 million, in occupied Donetsk Oblast, the military said.

item.title: Missile strikes reported across Russia as Belgorod faces blackouts and major oil pipeline hub in Tatarstan damaged
item.description: Explosions were reported overnight on Feb. 23 in Russia’s Belgorod, where officials said a large-scale missile strike caused significant damage to local infrastructure, as reports also emerged of attacks targeting energy and oil infrastructure elsewhere in Russia.Belgorod Governor Vyacheslav Gladkov said the city is reportedly facing disruptions

item.title: Zelensky says Putin has 'already started World War Three,' calls for stronger pressure on Russia
item.description: President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Feb. 23 in an interview with the BBC that Russian President Vladimir Putin has effectively already triggered World War Three, warning that only sustained military and economic pressure can prevent further escalation.
